title: Arkret Genesis Notary Binding Result
description: Own-Station signing input for a Realm genesis the authenticated caller is about to author. It carries the exact notary configuration to freeze into ak.realm.create and nothing else: no method history, no service document, no Realm reservation and no authorization to create.

genesis_notary_purpose.description: Realm purpose whose founding notary is the caller Station service identity. Identity-control genesis (principal_control, agent_control, applet_managed_control) fixes its own signer from accepted identity rules and is deliberately absent from this value space.

genesis_notary_request_body.description: Authenticated own-account request for the notary configuration of a genesis the caller will sign. The account pair is the exact authenticated session account and its serving Station; no candidate service id, DID or endpoint is accepted from the caller.

genesis_notary_outcome.description: Complete own-Station result. notary is copied verbatim into the genesis object; the caller still authors and signs the create Event itself. observed_at records the evaluation instant and is not a validity window or authorization lease, because the frozen descriptors become immutable historical Seal-signer truth once the genesis is accepted.
